<user_query>
Build Hold in this repo. Do not redo fork/mirror/clone. Do not research a different product. Do not invent a chatbot, a review dashboard, or a markdown-only permit.

READ FIRST, IN THIS ORDER
1. D:\BTW Hackathon\Hold\PRD.md — this is the spec. Implement that product.
2. D:\BTW Hackathon\BTW Buildathon 2026 - Participant Guide.docx — official day rules. Submission deadline is 3:00 PM IST, not 4:00.
3. .entire/graph-agent.md, then AGENTS.md — use Entire Graph before broad grep/read.

ALREADY DONE (DO NOT REPEAT)
- Track is E1 (Checkpoint-Native Developer Experience).
- Fork is https://github.com/AshwinSaklecha/cli from https://github.com/entireio/cli only. Do not fork entireio/entire-graph or entireio/external-agents. Graph is the installed plugin: entire graph …
- This folder D:\BTW Hackathon\cli is the judged clone. origin must stay entire://aws-ap-south-1.entire.io/gh/ashwinsaklecha/cli (India/Mumbai mirror).
- Entire CLI 0.10.5 is installed at D:\Scripts\entire.exe. Logged in as AshwinSaklecha, jurisdiction India. Graph plugin v0.4.0 is installed. Cursor hooks are enabled.
- Git main matches origin. Earlier junk setup commits were deleted on purpose.

UNCOMMITTED FILES ARE SETUP LEFTOVERS — KEEP THEM
Include them in the first Hold commit:
- .cursor/hooks.json
- .entire/settings.json (checkpoints must live on THIS fork / origin, not entireio/cli-checkpoints)
- .entire/graph-agent.md
- AGENTS.md
- CLAUDE.md
- demo/charge-api/README.md

WHAT TO BUILD
Hold is a gate, not a report. From the PRD:
- Fixture: tiny mock payments app in demo/charge-api (charge(), callers, retries, tests). Hold is tested on this, not a website.
- Commands: entire hold compile / check / amend / prove
- The product is check: an illegal charge() refactor must fail with exit 1, with file:line and callers. “AGENTS.md would have shipped this.”
- compile writes promises onto real functions (charter).
- amend is the noon path: official new rule updates the lock (CONFLICT / SUPERSEDED).
- prove = freeze did not move + tests + (if time) dependent-intent catch (VIP/holiday silent regression). Never skip check. Databricks and any cockpit are last and optional; check/prove must work with Databricks unplugged.

DO THIS
1. entire graph impact before risky edits. After the first agent commit, run entire checkpoint list. If it is empty, fix hooks (entire doctor / entire enable --agent cursor) and stop. Do not fake Hold on empty checkpoints.
2. First commit = required checkpoint: initial plan/architecture, plus the uncommitted setup files above.
3. Preserve commits with valid checkpoints: initial plan → pre-noon stable → curveball response → final verification.
4. Use Graph for: a search or def lookup; impact before a high-risk change; a final semantic-diff of the submitted work. Verify against source and tests. Never show raw Graph output as the product.
5. Add BUILDATHON.md at the repo root before submit (see participant guide outline). No secrets.
6. Push through origin (the Entire India remote).

CLOCK (IST)
- Now–11:45: build a working Hold + fixture. 11:45 last stable commit + checkpoint, product runnable.
- 12:00: stop this chat. Human gets the official Noon Curveball. Start a FRESH agent session, reconstruct from checkpoints + Graph, then hold amend. Do not skip the curveball.
- 1:00–3:00: implement constraint, test, Graph evidence, final checkpoint, BUILDATHON.md, submit.
- Submit by 3:00 PM IST. Keep the project runnable for judging 3:00–5:00.

HUMAN
GitHub: https://github.com/AshwinSaklecha
Windows. Cursor. Entire and GitHub are already set up on the machine.
</user_query>
